Description Generic task to define administration data (metamodel element AdminData) of an Identifiable within an AUTOSAR artifact. Note that administration data can be defined on several levels, namely for the top-level package of a General Autosar Artifact, but also for sub-packages and for other Identifiables within the XML description. Administration data include versioning information of the model element via the meta-class Doc Revision, and the aggregation of user specific data via so-called special data groups, meta-class Sdg. For more details on the administration data content see AUTOSAR_TPS_GenericStructure T emplate.pdf. Relation Type Related Element Mult.
